story: Zoe and Raj are cleaning the house. Raj makes a mistake and drops a dirty cup on the floor. Zoe helps him clean it up before lunch.
title: Cleaning the House
setting: A bright living room with a wooden floor.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow t-shirt

characters.name: Raj
characters.look: a young boy with black hair and a blue sweater

sentences.en: At the beginning, Raj is very fast.
sentences.zh: 在开始的时候，Raj动作很快。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj moves fast in the living room at the beginning.

sentences.en: He wants to move sixty small chairs.
sentences.zh: 他想移动六十把小椅子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj tries to move sixty small chairs across the room.

sentences.en: He makes a mistake and drops a cup.
sentences.zh: 他犯了一个错误，掉了一个杯子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj makes a mistake and drops a cup.

sentences.en: The dirty cup hits his left foot.
sentences.zh: 那个脏杯子撞到了他的左脚。
sentences.scene_prompt: A dirty cup hits Raj's foot on the floor.

sentences.en: The sun is low at four p.m.
sentences.scene_prompt: The sun is low in the sky at four p.m.

sentences.en: Zoe sees that cup on the floor.
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe looks at that dirty cup on the floor.

sentences.en: She will send him a lunch box.
sentences.zh: 她会给他送一个午餐盒。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe sends a lunch box to Raj.

sentences.en: He is the second boy to help.
sentences.zh: 他是第二个帮忙的男孩。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj is the second boy helping Zoe clean.
